verdict.rationale: WezTerm's feature docs say its SGR mouse reporting "works in vim and tmux", so running tmux inside the terminal is supported. It also ships its own tmux-like multiplexer with SSH domains, but that is an alternative to tmux, not an integration or control mode. A community user reports that WezTerm's image support did not play well with tmux, which limits the tmux-inside experience. missing for 10: documented native tmux control-mode integration, explicit first-party docs on tmux compatibility beyond mouse reporting, image protocol compatibility under tmux.

support.subject: As a developer, I can use tmux inside the terminal, or a documented native tmux integration/control mode

citations.quote: SGR style mouse reporting (works in vim and tmux)
